stated.rows: One row per token, keyed on its address in lower case: every token of the issuer's registry on the chain, the chain's gas coin, and each token another listing named that a verdict or a rule of scripts/risk/assets/robinhood.verdicts.json decides. A token is never a row on a listing's word alone: its decimals() and symbol() must answer on chain.
stated.enumeration: Names come from four reads, in this order: the issuer's registry (every row, not only the cut); Chainlink's directory (its feeds, and the names of the assets they price); the screening note of the dollar and yield tokens (docs/vault/research/yield-shelf/robinhood.md with its input list and its shelf fixture: every full address written there), with WETH9() of the Uniswap v4 position manager; DexScreener (searched as 'robinhood <name>' for every class name, then the pairs of each address the note names and of each name a search gave that names a class). Every address any of them named is read on chain.
stated.cryptoSelection: Crypto beyond the listings above (Rodrigo, 2026-10-11): every token CoinGecko's token list for Robinhood Chain (tokens.coingecko.com/robinhood/all.json) or Chainlink CCIP's token directory names on the chain, outside the issuer's registry, whose DexScreener pairs (tokens/v1, read the same day) traded ten thousand US dollars or more over 24 hours together, or whose symbol, in upper case, is the base asset of a Chainlink feed of the directory. The volume selects only and is never written in a row. Each selected token, each verdict's token and each row of a committed list is looked up on CoinGecko by its address, and one rule decides it (ASSET-1 review, 2026-10-12). A memecoin is never a row, by verdict or rule: a token in the chain's memecoin category (robinhood-chain-meme) or with a category whose name holds Meme (and not Ecosystem) or Themed. A token is governance only when CoinGecko files it, by the category's whole name, under one of: Decentralized Exchange (DEX), Lending/Borrowing Protocols, Perpetuals, Derivatives, Oracle, Bridge Governance Tokens, Infrastructure, Liquid Staking Governance Tokens, Yield Aggregator; or under Launchpad when it is the launch pad's own token (CoinGecko keeps a category '<its name> Launchpad' of the tokens launched on it); or its own verdict cites its project's own page (isOwnPage: an https URL whose host is not a listing, an aggregator, a directory or an explorer; CoinGecko, Jupiter, DexScreener, DefiLlama, Chainlink's directories, GeckoTerminal, an explorer or a repository path never is), or the build stops. A tag such as DeFi or AI, a chain, Governance alone, or what it was launched on or carried by admits nothing; a leveraged token never. Such a token is a row by the rule crypto-protocol (its project as issuer, its CoinGecko page as source). A liquid staking token by its categories (Liquid Staking Tokens, Liquid Staked ETH, Liquid Restaking Tokens) is a row by crypto-liquid-staking, category liquid_staking. A dollar CoinGecko files as a stablecoin must have its own verdict; any token but a memecoin may have its own verdict instead, which wins over every rule; any other is not a row. cryptoLeftOut counts them
stated.classNames: A DexScreener name names one of the product's classes when its symbol holds USD or EUR, or is, in upper case, a name of PROMPT_NAMES in scripts/risk-evm/assets-list.ts (the prompt's names for both chains), a base asset of Chainlink's directory or a symbol of the issuer's registry. Such names are read on chain, with any other the verdict table names; every one of them, and every token the screening note names, must be decided by a verdict or a rule, or the build stops. Other names are neither read nor enumerated: memecoins and launch tokens are not (DA6).
stated.rules: A rule matches a token when every key of its `match` holds for it: `listing`, a listing that named it (issuer_registry, screening_note, position_manager_weth9, dexscreener, coingecko, chainlink_ccip, previous_list, verdict_table); `classTable`, CLASS_BY_UNDERLYING of scripts/risk/universe/list.ts at the registry's symbol (SPY and QQQ etf, GLD gold, SLV and USO commodity, SGOV dollar_yield) and stock for every other symbol of the registry; `symbolOf`, issuer_registry for a token outside the registry whose symbol is a registry token's; `claims`, issuer_product where such a token's name names the issuer or the stock (claimsStock: it holds Robinhood, is the symbol, or begins with the first word of the stock's registry name), none where it does not; `coingecko`, what CoinGecko says of a token outside the registry (protocol, liquid_staking, stablecoin, meme, no_protocol_category, not_on_coingecko; see cryptoSelection); `protocol`, yes where that is protocol or liquid_staking, else no; `inUniverse`, yes for a token the crypto selection kept or a row of a committed list. The registry's tokens match issuer-registry and the class rule of their underlying; crypto-protocol and crypto-liquid-staking make a row of a token in the universe by its categories; a token with a registry stock's symbol that claims the stock matches not-the-issuers-stock-token, and one that does not claim it and is no protocol by its categories matches registry-symbol-not-a-protocol; both exclude it and come after the crypto rules, so they win. A symbol alone never excludes a protocol's token (NET, a lending protocol's, is decided by its categories). A memecoin by CoinGecko is no row whatever rule or verdict names it: a verdict for one stops the build
stated.derived: For a registry token the builder derives: underlying, the registry's symbol; status, listed for a tracked stock of scripts/risk/universe/robinhood.json (and the model of a deploy record's token) and candidate with 'outside the cut that names the tracked stocks (gate UNIVERSE)' for every other (DA16); leg types, from packages/engine/src/personal/leg-types.ts at the symbol for a dollar-yield token, none for the others; and a source naming the registry row. Rules and a token's own verdict are applied over these.
stated.listed: listed = on today's shelf: a tracked stock (tracked_stock), or a token a deploy record names (deploy_record): the model of an asset of deployments/robinhood-testnet.json by its modelOf, matched to the registry token of that symbol, or the cash token contracts/script/config/4663.json names by address (cashToken). No structurer registry row is on Robinhood Chain.
stated.ids: id: the tracked list's id, else the shelf fixture's (packages/engine/src/personal/fixtures/shelves/robinhood-yield.json), else robinhood:eth for the gas coin, else the id the address held in the newest committed list that held it (git history of scripts/risk/assets/robinhood.json; ids once given stay with their address), else robinhood:<slug of the symbol>. A kept id is dropped only where another row took it first, where it is over 96 characters (the schema's limit), or where it is an id the product's deploy records use (packages/sdk/deployments/*.json: robinhood:usdc, robinhood:usdg, robinhood:spy and the test network's) on a row that is not listed. A bare slug goes only to a listed row or to the one row whose symbol gives it, where no deploy record uses it; every other row takes a dash and the first six hex digits of its address (eight or more where six are taken)
stated.identity: symbol, name and decimals are what the contract answered at the block of `read.height` (name null where name() gives no text). The registry's own symbol, name, decimals, status, ISIN and multiplier are kept beside them in `issuerRegistry`, as the registry wrote them; nothing is applied. listingTags names the listings that named the token (issuer_registry, screening_note, position_manager_weth9, dexscreener).
stated.standard: erc4626 where asset() answers a non-zero address and convertToAssets(1e18) answers one word; erc20 for every other token; native for the gas coin.
stated.extensions: proxy: true where the EIP-1967 implementation slot holds an address, or the beacon slot does and the beacon's implementation() answers one; implementation is that address. false where the three slots are zero and the code has no DELEGATECALL, or the code is an EIP-1167 clone whose target has none (it cannot be upgraded). Null where the code delegates without a slot, or a clone's target delegates (its own slots are read and named). pausable and blacklist: true where a selector of CODE_SELECTORS (packages/risk/src/assets/evm.ts, listed in scripts/risk/assets/README.md) is pushed by the code that runs (the proxy and its implementation, or a clone's target), or where that code is a facet router (it pushes getFacet(bytes4)) whose getFacet(<selector>) names a facet that pushes it; null where none is found and the code that runs has a DELEGATECALL, or a code was not read (code_may_run_elsewhere); false only where none is found in code that does not delegate.
stated.authorities: owner: owner() (no_owner_function where it reverts, none where it answers the zero address). admin: behind a beacon, owner() of the beacon, which is who may change the code of every proxy of it; else the EIP-1967 admin slot. An empty admin slot is none only on a token that is not a proxy; on a proxy it is uups_upgrade_in_implementation where the implementation pushes upgradeTo, upgradeToAndCall or proxiableUUID, else admin_slot_empty_on_proxy, and admin_slot_empty_code_delegates on code that delegates without a slot; owner() and defaultAdmin() of the token are named in the read. Who a role-based contract (AccessControl) lets act is not read.
stated.oracle: A Chainlink feed of the directory, tied to a token and confirmed on chain at the block by the rule of the oracle map (scripts/risk-evm/feeds.ts matchToken: the name and the contract's description() must read as a US dollar price of the symbol, letters as written; decimals() as the directory says; a positive answer not after the block). The twins check is over the rows not excluded; an excluded row gets no feed (excluded_row). A feed names an asset, not an address: it is not tied to a token whose issuer no verdict or rule names (issuer_not_confirmed). Where the directory names the symbol in another case only, the reason says so (feed_named_in_other_case_not_tied). A tracked stock's oracle is in its tracked row. prices is what the directory says the feed prices (token_with_multiplier for a primaryTokenizedPrice product, token_from_pools for dex_state_price), else null. No answer of a feed is stored.
stated.pools: pools.confirmed and pools.unconfirmed: see poolCount. A pool with a stock token of the issuer registry is counted from the discovery file of RU.2 (confirmed by the v3 factory or the v4 pool manager, unconfirmed when only DexScreener named it: the venues that are not Uniswap v3 or v4 are not read, D4, BYREAL-D4); a pool with none is counted from this run's DexScreener answers, unconfirmed. The gas coin is the zero address in pools. no_known_pool where neither knows one. A tracked stock's pools are in its tracked row.
stated.noFigures: Nothing in a row is a price, a TVL, a supply or a yield. The registry multiplier is its text, applied to nothing.
stated.cryptoLeftOut: Of the 207 tokens the crypto selection kept, 21 are rows; the others are not, by CoinGecko's page of each: meme 72, no_protocol_category 113, not_on_coingecko 1 (meme: a category of memecoins; no_protocol_category: no category that names a protocol, a chain or a product, matched whole; not_on_coingecko: no page for the address).
